dialogues.speaker: Hastily-Written Notes
dialogues.text: "Day 4: No progress. No idea why the boss is so obsessed with this place."

dialogues.speaker: Hastily-Written Notes
dialogues.text: "Day 7: Boss says she's had an idea, but so far it mostly seems to involve her waiting by the ruin... Don't ask me what for, because there's a great big Ruin Hunter guarding it, so there's no way she's getting in. Not quite sure how this counts as progress."
